newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary plans next Malev sell-off phase by Apr 30.
newsitem.headline: Hungary plans next Malev sell-off phase by Apr 30.

text.p: Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt said on Friday it would work out a strategy for national airline Malev Rt's further privatisation by April 30.
"The further privatisation of Malev has to be done in more steps, parallel with a capital increase," an APV statement said.
It added that the state's stake in the airline must remain 50 percent plus one vote.
In order to maintain Malev's competitive position in Europe, APV's board will ask the government to exempt the company from import duty on leased airplanes.

The state has a 63.9 percent stake in Malev, Italy's Alitalia Spa a 30 percent stake, Italy's Simest (Societa Italiana per le imprese miste all estero) a five percent stake while local governments hold 0.6 percent.
